procedural_matters: GBR 4 was represented by Rhos Hawes.
GER 21 was represented by Simon Heindl.
Simon Heindl (helm of GER 21) provided video evidence.
Fin Armstrong (GBR 590) gave evidence as a witness for GBR 4.
Cxema Pico (International Jury) provided video evidence
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 4 to 5 knots of wind and flat water.
GER 21 was approaching Mark 1 on a starboard tack on the layline.
When GER 21 reached the mark, GBR 590’s bow became slightly overlapped to windward of the starboard wing of GER 21.
GER 21 rounded the mark with 10 cms. distance between her port wing and the mark.
conclusions: There was no contact between GER 21 and mark 1. GER 21 did not break rule 31.
